name: Do I need to replace all my siding if only a few panels are wind damaged?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to replace all my siding if only a few panels are wind damaged?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. If only a few panels are damaged and replacement materials are available that closely match your existing siding, a spot repair or partial replacement can often be performed. However, if your siding is older and a perfect match is impossible, or if there's widespread damage across multiple areas, then replacing a larger section or all of the siding on a particular side might be a more aesthetically and structurally sound option.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, often only damaged panels are replaced if a match is available. Widespread damage or poor matching might lead to larger section replacement.
